item.blurb: Physicl Raises $10M Seed. Physicl raises $10 million in seed funding led by Inovia Capital to expand its AI platform for generating training data for physical robotics models.
Sand.ai Raises $200M Series A Extension. Sand.ai raises $200M in a Series A+ round to reach a $1B valuation, aiming to advance its open-source AI video generation platform and global presence.
Synctera Raises $24.5M in Funding. Synctera raises $24.5M to support its embedded finance and banking-as-a-service platform as it moves toward break-even status.
